videos.title: First Look at Nintendo Switch 2 40th Anniversary Zelda Edition
videos.description:
Nintendo went all out with theming this special edition Switch 2 for the 40th anniversary of 'The Legend of Zelda.'

At a holiday showcase, Nintendo only had the console and matching Joy-Con 2 controllers and dock and the Switch 2 Pro Controller and stand (sold separately or together) behind Plexiglas. Still, it was enough for me to peep all the little touches.

videos.title: Hands on with Amazon Kindle Click
videos.description:
Amazon introduced the Bluetooth page-turning remote called the Kindle Click. The $34.99 clicker has two big buttons for turning back and forward on e-books and two buttons on the right side for adjusting screen brightness. It’s basically Amazon’s answer to page-turning remotes like the Boox Tappy.

The only catch is that the Kindle Click supports Kindles from 2024 or later. Sorry, older Kindles are SOL.
